raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Ungated MoE adapters, such as Nemotron adapters exported with an expert `up_proj` and `down_proj`, leave the input projection under `up_proj` during loading. SGLang's fused MoE buffers expect `gate_up_proj` even when the expert has only one input projection, so the adapter input projection does not reach the expected buffer.

## Modifications

- Rename orphan routed-expert `up_proj` tensors to `gate_up_proj` when the base layer is ungated, preserving the original tensor and single-projection shape for both per-expert and packed layouts.
- Preserve existing `gate_proj` exports, including empty `up_proj` placeholders in either checkpoint key order, and leave gated expert stacking unchanged.
- Retain `up_proj` as an eligible target when the base model also has standalone dense/shared-expert modules. Those weights keep their standalone names.

## Accuracy Tests

21 CPU regression cases pass against this change and the pinned Spindle backport; eight fail on the parent revision. The tests execute the production normalizer and target-inference methods in isolation, without GPU backend imports. The local run used CPU PyTorch and bypassed top-level SGLang package initialization to load the CI registration helper; full runtime dependencies are not installed locally.

Coverage includes LoRA A/B tensors, per-expert and packed weights, mixed gated/ungated layers, dense/shared experts, empty placeholders, and explicit/inferred target lists. The tests are registered with `base-a-test-cpu`. Repository pre-commit checks pass. End-to-end Nemotron GPU accuracy has not been run for this draft.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. This changes adapter loading and target selection; no inference kernel changes or throughput claims.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with the repository's pre-commit checks.
- [x] Add CPU unit tests and CI registration.
- [ ] Update documentation (no user-facing API change).
- [ ] Provide GPU accuracy and speed benchmarks.
- [x] Follow SGLang code style.

Upstreams the image backport discussed in https://github.com/modal-projects/spindle/pull/35#discussion_r4251364796. The matching Miles validation fix is https://github.com/radixark/miles/pull/4032.

         self, weight_names: List[str], weights: Dict[str, torch.Tensor]

-            if "gate_proj" in weight_name:
+            if ".up_proj." in weight_name and self._is_non_gated_moe_weight(
+                weight_name
+            ):
+                gate_name = weight_name.replace(".up_proj.", ".gate_proj.")
+                if weight_name in weights and gate_name not in weights:
+                    # Non-gated experts can export their single input projection
+                    # as up_proj. The fused MoE buffer still calls it gate_up_proj.
+                    merged_name = weight_name.replace(".up_proj.", ".gate_up_proj.")
+                    weights[merged_name] = weights.pop(weight_name)
+            elif "gate_proj" in weight_name:
                 up_name = weight_name.replace("gate_proj", "up_proj")
                 gate_up_name = weight_name.replace("gate_proj", "gate_up_proj")
                 # PEFT can ship up_proj in two forms when there's no real
@@ -496,7 +505,7 @@ def normalize_gate_up_proj(

                     weights[gate_up_name] = weights[gate_up_name].repeat(*repeat_dims)
                 # else: no-op as LoRA B weight is already stacked.

                 # Otherwise, infer target_modules from adapter configs.
                 self.target_modules.update(adapter_target_modules)
 
+        # Normalization maps up_proj to gate_up_proj for fused MoE weights.
+        # Keep standalone dense/shared-expert up_proj modules eligible too.
+        if "gate_up_proj" in self.target_modules and any(
+            name.endswith(".up_proj") for name, _ in self.base_model.named_modules()

+"""CPU tensor-layout regressions without importing GPU-only LoRA backends."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ast
+import logging
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+SRT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4] / "python/sglang/srt"
+
+
+def _load_definitions(path, names, namespace, class_name=None):
+    """Execute the production helpers while avoiding CUDA import side effects."""
+    tree = ast.parse(path.read_text())
+    if class_name:
+        tree = next(
+            node for node in tree.body if getattr(node, "name", None) == class_name
+        )
+    body = [
+        ast.ImportFrom(
+            module="__future__", names=[ast.alias(name="annotations")], level=0
+        )
+    ]
+    body += [
+        node
+        for node in tree.body
+        if getattr(node, "name", None) in names
+        or (
+            isinstance(node, ast.Assign)
+            and any(
+                isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id in names
+                for target in node.targets
+            )
+        )
+    ]
+    module = ast.fix_missing_locations(ast.Module(body=body, type_ignores=[]))
+    exec(compile(module, str(path), "exec"), namespace)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def helpers():
+    namespace = {"torch": torch, "re": re, "logger": logging.getLogger(__name__)}
+    _load_definitions(SRT / "layers/utils/common.py", {"get_layer_id"}, namespace)
+    _load_definitions(SRT / "lora/lora.py", {"_ROUTED_EXPERT_PATTERN"}, namespace)
+    _load_definitions(
+        SRT / "lora/lora.py",
+        {"normalize_gate_up_proj", "_is_non_gated_moe_weight"},
+        namespace,
+        "LoRAAdapter",
+    )
+    _load_definitions(
+        SRT / "lora/utils.py",
+        {"get_normalized_target_modules", "EMBEDDING_NAMES", "DSA_INDEXER_LORA_NAMES"},
+        namespace,
+    )
+    _load_definitions(
+        SRT / "lora/lora_manager.py", {"init_lora_shapes"}, namespace, "LoRAManager"
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(**namespace)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def adapter(helpers):
+    adapter_type = type(
+        "Adapter",
+        (),
+        {
+            "normalize_gate_up_proj": helpers.normalize_gate_up_proj,
+            "_is_non_gated_moe_weight": helpers._is_non_gated_moe_weight,
+        },
+    )
+    instance = adapter_type()
+    instance._moe_is_gated_by_layer = {0: False, 1: True}
+    return instance
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("expert", ["experts.0", "experts"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("factor, shape", [("A", (2, 4)), ("B", (6, 2))])
+def test_ungated_up_proj_keeps_single_projection_shape(adapter, expert, factor, shape):
+    if expert == "experts":
+        shape = (3, *shape)
+    weight = torch.arange(torch.tensor(shape).prod().item()).reshape(shape)
+    name = f"model.layers.0.mlp.{expert}.up_proj.lora_{factor}.weight"
+    weights = {name: weight}
+
+    adapter.normalize_gate_up_proj(list(weights), weights)
+
+    merged = name.replace(".up_proj.", ".gate_up_proj.")
+    assert set(weights) == {merged}
+    assert weights[merged] is weight
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "prefix", ["mlp", "mlp.shared_experts", "mlp.shared_experts.0"]
+)
+def test_dense_and_shared_up_proj_keep_standalone_names(adapter, prefix):
+    name = f"model.layers.0.{prefix}.up_proj.lora_A.weight"
+    weight = torch.ones(2, 4)
+    weights = {name: weight}
+    adapter.normalize_gate_up_proj(list(weights), weights)
+    assert set(weights) == {name}
+    assert weights[name] is weight
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("up_first", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("empty_up", [False, True])
+def test_existing_ungated_gate_proj_exports(adapter, up_first, empty_up):
+    gate = "model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0.gate_proj.lora_A.weight"
+    up = gate.replace("gate_proj", "up_proj")
+    weight = torch.ones(2, 4)
+    weights = {gate: weight}
+    if empty_up:
+        weights[up] = torch.empty(0)
+    names = list(weights)
+    if up_first:
+        names.reverse()
+
+    adapter.normalize_gate_up_proj(names, weights)
+
+    merged = gate.replace("gate_proj", "gate_up_proj")
+    assert set(weights) == {merged}
+    assert weights[merged] is weight
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("up_first", [False, True])
+def test_mixed_gated_and_ungated_layers(adapter, up_first):
+    ungated = "model.layers.0.mlp.experts.0.up_proj.lora_A.weight"
+    gate = "model.layers.1.mlp.experts.0.gate_proj.lora_A.weight"
+    up = gate.replace("gate_proj", "up_proj")
+    weights = {
+        ungated: torch.ones(2, 4),
+        gate: torch.ones(2, 4),
+        up: torch.full((2, 4), 2.0),
+    }
+    names = list(weights)
+    if up_first:
+        names.reverse()
+
+    adapter.normalize_gate_up_proj(names, weights)
+
+    assert weights[ungated.replace("up_proj", "gate_up_proj")].shape == (2, 4)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        weights[gate.replace("gate_proj", "gate_up_proj")],
+        torch.cat((torch.ones(2, 4), torch.full((2, 4), 2.0))),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("explicit_targets", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("standalone_up", [False, True])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("targets", [["up_proj", "down_proj"], ["q_proj", "v_proj"]])
+def test_target_inference_preserves_standalone_up_proj(
+    helpers, explicit_targets, standalone_up, targets
+):
+    module_names = ["model.layers.0.mlp.experts"]
+    if standalone_up:
+        module_names.append("model.layers.0.mlp.shared_experts.up_proj")
+    manager = SimpleNamespace(
+        base_model=SimpleNamespace(
+            named_modules=lambda: [(name, None) for name in module_names]
+        ),
+        configs={"adapter": SimpleNamespace(target_modules=targets, r=2)},
+        lora_added_tokens_size=0,
+    )
+    helpers.init_lora_shapes(
+        manager, target_modules=set(targets) if explicit_targets else None
+    )
+    expected = {"gate_up_proj", "down_proj"} if "up_proj" in targets else {"qkv_proj"}
+    if standalone_up and "up_proj" in targets:
+        expected.add("up_proj")
+    assert manager.target_modules == expected
